case_title: Omveer Singh v. State of Uttar Pradesh & Anr.
statutory_provisions: IPC s.323, s.376; Dowry Prohibition Act s.3, s.4
high_court_outcome: Application for quashing of proceedings dismissed
neutral_facts: The accused, who was married to the victim, filed an application under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure to quash the proceedings initiated against him in a complaint case. The complaint case involved allegations under Sections 498A, 323, and 376 of the Indian Penal Code, as well as Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act. The High Court dismissed the application, and the accused appealed against this decision. The Supreme Court found that the High Court did not adequately consider the factual matrix of the case and remanded the matter back to the High Court for reconsideration on its merits.
